subject: Judge: review installer Claude-CLI-dep + env-merge + --headless-drains opt-in
description: Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge review mode) of the installer task's attempt branch. Fetch the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff) and apply the rubric: (a) Claude CLI detection WARNS (does not hard-fail) when absent — a normal install still succeeds without the CLI; (b) installMcp now MERGES the orchestrator-graph env instead of overwriting — verify ORCH_RERANK_ALPHA/ORCH_RERANK_K and any pre-existing keys SURVIVE a simulated reinstall (this was the actual latent bug); (c) the --headless-drains flag writes ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=1 to BOTH .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json, AND crucially a NORMAL (no-flag) install does NOT set the flag (headless drains off by default); tests cover all three; scope limited to bin/install.js (+ its test). APPROVE = hold for dispatcher merge to main (flat task). KICK BACK = set_status failed + a wired record_decision. NEVER force-merge.
